service "isolated" {
  image = "example"
  version = "latest"
  replicas = null
  how_to_update = "stop-old-first"
  restart_policy = "on-failure"
  net {
    mode = "none"
  }
  ram_mb = 16
}

-------------
services:
  isolated:
    deploy:
      update_config:
        order: stop-first
      resources:
        limits:
          memory: "16777216"
    environment:
      LOGGER_SUPPRESS_TIMESTAMPS: "1"
    image: example:latest
    network_mode: none
    restart: on-failure
